name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
summary: High-performance Multimodal open-weights model by DeepSeek, trending with over 3,069 community likes and 95,889 downloads on Hugging Face.
architecture: DeepSeek image text to text architecture with community-tuned weights.
usage:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017", device_map="auto")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017")
limitations: Requires GPU VRAM or quantization for efficient local deployment.
